docs.text:
The Sāṅkhāyana, Āśvalāyana, Pāraskara, Khādira and Gobhila Gṛhya-sūtras in Oldenberg’s English: the Vedic household rites of birth, initiation, marriage and the funeral (Oxford, 1886). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Grihya-sutras, rules of Vedic domestic ceremonies · Oldenberg, Hermann, 1854-1920, ed. and tr, Müller, F. Max (Friedrich Max), 1823-1900 ed. and tr · 1886-92, 502 scanned pages. Published 1886; Hermann Oldenberg died 1920 and F. Max Müller 1900; the texts are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
